MING SERIES · LED SPOTLIGHTS

Ming Series Recessed LED Wall Washer with Ø55 mm Cutout

The ELVARO Lighting Ming Series Recessed LED Wall Washer is a compact ceiling spotlight for feature walls, textured finishes and architectural details. Its Bridgelux LED delivers a color rendering index of Ra > 95, helping wood, stone and display materials retain their natural appearance under accent lighting.

OverviewSpecificationsApplications

Configure your recessed wall wash spotlight

The fixture is available in 5 W and 7 W versions, with 15°, 24°, 36° and 50° beam angle options. Choose from 3000 K, 4000 K or 6000 K fixed white, or a 2700–6000 K tunable white configuration. The Ø65 × 72 mm die-cast aluminum housing fits a Ø55 mm ceiling cutout and mounts with three-prong spring clips.

Share your ceiling height, wall setback and preferred color temperature to discuss a configuration and request a project quote.
